{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Warren County Canal was a branch of the Miami and Erie Canal in southwestern Ohio about 20 mi in length that connected the Warren County seat of Lebanon to the main canal at Middletown in the mid-19th century.","title":"Warren County Canal"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Lebanon was at the crossroads of two major roads, the highway from Cincinnati to Columbus (later U.S. Route 42) and the road from Chillicothe to the College Township (Oxford), but Lebanon businessmen and civic leaders wanted better transportation facilities and successfully lobbied for their own canal, part of the canal fever of the first third of the 19th century.","title":"Warren County Canal"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The Warren County Canal was never successful, operating less than a decade before the state abandoned it.","title":"Warren County Canal"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Warren County School District (WCSD) is a public school district in Warren County, Pennsylvania, and it is designed to encompass all but three county municipalities.","title":"Warren County School District"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It has four attendance areas: North, East, West and Central.","title":"Warren County School District"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Warren County School District encompasses approximately 792 square miles.","title":"Warren County School District"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" According to 2000 federal census data, it serves a resident population of 40,689.","title":"Warren County School District"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" In 2009, the residents' per capita income was $17,898, while median family income was $42,714.","title":"Warren County School District"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" In the Commonwealth, the median family income was","title":"Warren County School District"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Which canal is located farther east, Champlain Canal or Warren County Canal?"}
